name: app-research-findings-long-sheet-with-black-bar-charts
title: Research Findings with Black Segmented Bars
whatItIs: A tall white sheet with a headline about user insights and three question cards (one black, two white) each with a large percentage and a segmented bar of solid and ticked segments, with Group A, B and C icon tiles and a huge faint logo behind.
whatItMeans: Segmented bars are compact and tactile, and mixing one dark card with light ones creates rhythm.
techniques: Segmented bars with a solid block then tick marks
One dark card among light ones
Big percentage plus a short label
Group tiles with the brand mark as icons

vocabulary.definition: A bar built from solid and ticked segments.
A card with a question and its top answers.
An oversized low-contrast logo behind content.
